is a [[skill gem]] that turns a linked [[spell]] into a [[trigger]] skill. The [[brand]] periodically triggers all linked spells in a sequence while being attached to an enemy. ==Skill functions and interactions== The gem consists of two components: a [[skill]] part '''Arcanist Brand''' and a support part '''Arcanist Brand Support'''. It does not however have the [[:Category:Support (gem tag)|Support]] gem tag. It is one of the few skill/support [[hybrid gem]]s. '''Arcanist Brand''': * {{c|mod|Increases and Reductions to Cast Speed also apply to this Skill's Activation frequency}} ** Arcanist Brand's [[cast speed]] determines how long it takes to cast the brand itself. The activation frequency is how often the brand triggers linked spells. Both of these are increased by cast speed modifiers. More/less modifiers (e.g. {{il|Spell Echo Support}}) and modifiers to [[action speed]] will only affect the brand's cast time, and not its activation frequency. '''Arcanist Brand Support''': * The following restrictions apply from the description of the support gem part of Arcanist Brand: {{c|mod|Supports spell skills that have no reservation. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.}} * The {{c|mod|Supported Skills deal (69-63)% less Damage}} and {{c|mod|Supported Skills Deal (40-59)% more Damage with Hits against Branded Enemy}} modifiers are multiplicative, resulting in a final modifier of 57% less damage dealt with hits against the branded enemy at level 1, scaling up to 41% less at level 20. * {{c|mod|Projectiles from Supported Skills have 4.8 metres maximum range}}: This modifier limits the maximum travel distance of projectiles, and may be advantageous for projectiles with a limited lifetime like {{il|Eye of Winter}}, allowing them to [[return]] to the branded enemy sooner or with less investment in projectile speed. * Skills that summon [[minion]]s can be triggered, but Arcanist Brand Support's {{c|mod|Cannot modify the skills of minions}} means it cannot add stats to minions or their skills. Minions are unaffected by Arcanist Brand Support's penalties or bonuses, and they will not cast their own brands. ** {{c|mod|Projectiles from Supported Skills have 4.8 metres maximum range}} ''does'' modify minions' projectiles however, though this may be a bug.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3519727 '''Triggering''' * While attached to an enemy, Arcanist Brand will [[trigger]] 1 linked spell with each activation in a sequence until its [[duration]] runs out. This can allow the character to apply multiple spells with one cast, assuming the brand has enough duration. ** With its base 3 seconds of attachment duration, 3 linked spell skills will each trigger once before expiring. * Skills triggered by Arcanist Brand do not count as 'Brand Skills', but ''do'' count as dealing Brand Damage and Brand Critical Strikes for modifiers like {{c|mod|#% increased Brand Damage}} and {{c|mod|+#% to Brand Critical Strike Chance/Multiplier}}.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/gvkzak/arcanist_brand_i_know_we_dont_have_a_lot_of_info/fspdudk/ * {{il|Brand Recall}} will activate all brands, triggering one of the linked spells, even for brands that were not attached to a target. * Arcanist Brand cannot itself be triggered by support gems or items. Skills it supports follow general [[trigger]] mechanics, becoming disabled if they gain a trigger in addition to Arcanist Brand. '''Targeting''' * Arcanist Brand auto-targets enemies with precision. This can be useful for skills such as {{il|Desecrate}}, which will place [[corpse]]s close to enemies. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = less
